label: Fortune Lantern
effect: Reveal every connected unrevealed room once before choosing a route.
naturalAcquisition: Room chest; Scout Lodge; early Tower milestone

label: Field Hospital Kit
effect: Gain one emergency recovery use and remove one temporary expedition debuff.

label: Gilded Route Map
effect: Add two reachable treasure rooms to the committed board.
naturalAcquisition: Map room; Scout Lodge; chapter completion

label: Hidden-Door Chalk
drawbackOrCost: Secret may contain a hazard or elite guard.

label: Forge Commission
effect: Choose one weapon or armor family; found equipment is more likely to match it.
drawbackOrCost: Some enemies also gain improved equipment.

label: Lucky Cache Key
effect: Upgrade one revealed chest by one rarity tier, capped at Epic.

label: Blood-Iron Challenge Writ
effect: Enemies gain better formations and Arts; XP, materials, and high-rarity loot increase.
naturalAcquisition: Contract House; boss reward; challenge clear

label: War Horn of Pursuit
effect: Normal battles may add one enemy Union; boss chest is at least Rare.
naturalAcquisition: Union Command; Tower floor 15; elite reward

label: Champion's Bounty
effect: Add an optional miniboss room awarding a named Rare-or-better item.
drawbackOrCost: Optional route is dangerous and increases Threat.

label: Rescue Charter
effect: Guarantee one rescue room with civic, recruit, relationship, or Turning Point rewards.
drawbackOrCost: Failure may create injury or city consequence.
naturalAcquisition: Civic milestone; relationship quest; city defense

label: Chronicle Page
effect: Guarantee one significant character event capable of creating a Turning Point.
drawbackOrCost: Outcome may include a scar, obligation, or complication.

label: Epic Cache Map
effect: Guarantee one reachable guarded Epic Chest.
drawbackOrCost: Elite encounter, severe hazard, or both.
naturalAcquisition: Chapter boss; Tower floor 50; code giveaway

label: Cursed Standard
effect: Mission boss gains an additional phase; reward improves by one tier.
drawbackOrCost: Boss power and special mechanics increase.
naturalAcquisition: Rare boss drop; high Tower checkpoint

label: Recall Beacon
effect: On defeat, retain all unsecured Tower rewards and extract safely.

label: Tower Scout Lens
effect: Preview the next three floor modifiers before choosing to continue.
drawbackOrCost: Does not reveal exact enemy actions.

label: Boss Cache Seal
effect: Upgrade the next boss cache by one tier.
drawbackOrCost: Boss gains +10% power and one enhanced behavior.

label: Art Echo Prism
effect: Select one Art tree; double meaningful-use mastery gain for the next three battles.
drawbackOrCost: Only meaningful legal use counts; no free mastery.
naturalAcquisition: Full Art branch mastery; Archive; Tower floor 40
